name: skill-creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills for Apollo GraphQL and GraphQL development. Use this skill when: (1) users want to create a new skill, (2) users want to update an existing skill, (3) users ask about skill structure or best practices, (4) users need help writing SKILL.md files.

findings.excerpt: - NEVER include `Bash(curl:*)` in `allowed-tools` as it grants unrestricted network access and enables `curl | sh` remote code execution patterns
